structure.structure_en: Living room, rectangular, roughly square plan, 3.6 m x 3.2 m; ceiling 2.7 m; floor: bare mottled grey cement screed, continuous monolithic plane, no tiles or planks, no steps or level changes. Front-right window 0.9 x 1.2 m, sill 1.2 m, 60% along the wall. Camera 1.5 m high, 3 m to the far wall, 24 mm lens, tilt -8 degrees, horizon 45% of frame height. The number of openings is exactly 1; do not add or remove any opening. Fixed features that stay: brick masonry walls: exposed grey clay brick in running bond on both visible planes, untreated; cement plaster dado: rough grey render to lower ~1 m of wall, irregular top edge; window shutter layout: timber framed opening with two vertical solid-wood shutter leaves and central mullion; internal corner: sharp 90-degree brick corner joining left and front-right walls.
structure.structure_en_model: The room is a roughly rectangular space of about 3.6 by 3.2 metres with a presumed flat ceiling at 2.7 metres, not seen in frame. Two exposed grey brick masonry walls meet at a sharp internal corner left of centre, each finished at the base with a rough cement plaster dado rising to about one metre and no skirting. The front-right wall carries a single timber-framed window about 0.9 metres wide and 1.2 metres high with a 1.3 metre sill, closed by two solid vertical wood shutter leaves and a central mullion. The floor is a continuous monolithic grey cement screed with no level changes. The camera stands 1.5 metres high in two-point perspective angled toward the corner, tilted slightly down with a 24 mm wide lens.
